title: 7-day motor imagery BCI EEG dataset from Zhou et al 2021
description: A longitudinal EEG dataset of motor imagery brain-computer interface (MI-BCI) recordings from 20 healthy participants across 7 sessions on separate days, without feedback training. Participants imagined left-hand, right-hand and both-feet movements, or rested, in response to visual arrow cues. EEG was recorded at 500 Hz with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 amplifier (41 EEG channels plus 2 EOG channels), yielding 33,600 trials. The data are provided in BIDS format with HED event annotations, regenerated via the MOABB Zhou2020 loader.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 system using Ag/AgCl electrodes, Cz reference and AFz ground, sampled at 500 Hz with online 0.5-100 Hz bandpass and 50 Hz notch filtering. Each of 7 daily sessions had 6 runs of 40 trials, with 5 s cued trials for four classes: left hand, right hand, feet and rest.
